title: FINAL LOGIN FLOW DECOUPLING REFACTOR

login_success_condition.success_definition: AuthProvider.login resolves after loginRequest returns a successful /auth/login response.

removed_login_dependencies.details: AuthProvider.login no longer waits for sessionCheckRequest; /auth/me remains only as a background session probe.
getCapabilityBootstrap runs from CapabilityStateProvider after the protected UI has rendered.
ModuleAccessProvider derives state from CapabilityStateProvider and is mounted inside AuthGuard, after route auth gating.
AdapterAccessProvider derives state from CapabilityStateProvider and is mounted inside AuthGuard, after route auth gating.
PermissionRouteGuard runs only after the console shell is mounted; login does not await permission material.

final_login_flow: AuthProvider stores identity from the login response and marks status authenticated.
Capability, module, adapter, and route permission UI state load asynchronously after the protected route has rendered.
